name: c0de Data
landing_text: This book lists the blocks that describe data. Type blocks say what kind of value something holds. LABEL, LITERAL, VARIABLE, CONSTANT and TAG name values, hold them and store them. Each page shows what a block does, how to craft it and a short example. The examples use the text notation of the guide: one text line is one line on the sheet, and four spaces mean one block further east.
